name: gizza-ai/scan-to-pdf
summary: Turn document photos into a cleaned, deskewed, high-contrast PDF scan.

tool.description: Turn one or more phone photos of documents into a cleaned, deskewed, high-contrast multi-page PDF scan (one page per photo, in order). Each photo is a URL or a `ref` to an uploaded image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP). Choose an enhancement mode (magic colour, grayscale, black & white, or plain colour), auto-straighten a small tilt, rotate for orientation, tune brightness/contrast, and pick the output page size (fit/A4/Letter). Note: does NOT do 4-corner auto-crop/perspective de-warp or OCR/searchable text.

brightness.description: Brightness offset from -100 to 100 (0 = none). Positive brightens; in blackwhite mode it also keeps less ink (whiter background). Default 0.

contrast.description: Contrast multiplier around mid-grey (0.5–3.0, 1.0 = none). Applies in magic/grayscale/color modes; higher = punchier text. Default 1.0.

deskew.description: Auto-straighten a small tilt (up to ±12°) by detecting the skew angle and rotating to undo it. Default true. Turn off to keep the photo's original angle.

images.description: Ordered list of document-photo sources (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP). Each item has exactly one of `url` or `ref`. One cleaned page per photo, in order.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

mode.description: Enhancement filter. magic (default): whiten the paper, lift contrast + saturation for the everyday colour 'office scan'. grayscale: perception-weighted grey. blackwhite: adaptive local-mean threshold → crisp pure black-on-white, despeckled, for forms/contracts. color: keep colour, only apply brightness/contrast.

page_size.description: Output page size. fit (default): one page sized exactly to each photo. a4 / letter: scale each photo to fit a centred A4 (595×842 pt) or US Letter (612×792 pt) page.

rotate.description: Manual clockwise rotation in degrees for phone orientation, applied before deskew: 0 (default), 90, 180 or 270.
